task.title: Full-text search across wiki, tasks and code
task.body:
The command palette matches titles and paths only. Search should also find text inside pages, task descriptions and code.

- [ ] Use `git grep` for tracked files (works on every host, respects `.gitignore`)
- [ ] Show matches with context in the palette, grouped by area
- [ ] Jump to the line in the code editor, or to the heading in a page
